links.outcome: Deviation of ChatGPT meal plan energy and protein content from CKD targets
links.effect: Prescribed energy was 17.0% to 28.9% below target; protein was 59.3% to 157% above target.
links.quote: For the quantitative analysis, the prescribed energy levels were generally lower than the targets, ranging from -28.9% to -17.0%, and protein contents were tremendously higher than the targets, ranging from 59.3% to 157%.

screen.reason: Evaluates the capability and nutritional safety/accuracy of ChatGPT in generating simulated personalized dietary plans for chronic kidney disease patients without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
